statement: At c11 authoring time, two of c11's declared deps (f02 .enforce/ scaffold, c10 CI/binary-bootstrap release pipeline) are still TODO/PENDING in the tree -- enforcer-cli's Command::Install/Plan/Proof/Coordination are literal unwired stubs (main.rs dispatch prints "routed to arc-2X; not wired in this skeleton" and returns InternalError), and there is no crates/enforcer-install/src/ci/** module yet. c11's own owned scope (skills/enforcer-onboarding/SKILL.md + its two fixtures + the 4-test proof) does not require those to exist -- the skill instead names f02/c10 by workpack id and instructs the agent to report the gap honestly rather than fabricate a CLI surface.
why: Any future worker landing f02 or c10 should know the onboarding skill already references them by name/step and will need a light doc-only touch-up (not a rewrite) once those subcommands are real; any worker reading TEST_PROOF_EXPECTATIONS.md's Track F f02 row (PENDING) or c10's WORKPACK_INDEX row (TODO) should trust that status over any prose elsewhere implying they landed.
howToApply: When f02 lands `enforcer onboard`, and when c10 lands the CI/binary-bootstrap module, re-read skills/enforcer-onboarding/SKILL.md steps 4 and 5 and replace the 'if not yet landed, report the gap' language with the real command surface -- do not need to restructure the skill's 7-step shape.

evidence.ref: crates/enforcer-cli/src/main.rs dispatch() Command::Install/Plan/Proof/Coordination arms; docs/plans/enforcer-selfhost-plan/TEST_PROOF_EXPECTATIONS.md Track F f02 row = PENDING; WORKPACK_INDEX.md c10 row = TODO

statement: enforcer-config's EffectiveConfig has NO `languages` field -- `languages` is an accepted-but-out-of-scope top-level config JSON key (arc-04/lang-*-owned scope per the crate's own OUT_OF_SCOPE_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS cover-all test in crates/enforcer-config/src/lib.rs), so it round-trips through raw JSON parsing but never surfaces on the typed EffectiveConfig struct returned by load_project_config/resolve. A caller that wants the declared languages today must read the raw config JSON directly rather than the resolved struct.
why: Any future test or CLI code that assumes `EffectiveConfig.languages` exists will fail to compile; this is a real, documented gap (not a bug) until arc-04/lang-* wires a typed field for it.
howToApply: When consuming a project's declared languages before arc-04 lands a typed field, parse the raw ocentra-enforcer.config.json JSON's `languages` array directly (as crates/enforcer-install/tests/onboarding_skill_fixtures.rs does) rather than expecting it on EffectiveConfig.

evidence.ref: crates/enforcer-config/src/lib.rs OUT_OF_SCOPE_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS const listing "languages"; crates/enforcer-config/src/model.rs EffectiveConfig struct (no languages field)
